descriptions.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

这是一个晶态球状物体，与我们开发的§Y裂隙探球§!技术极其相似，该技术使我们能够探索其他维度。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大的未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有价值的关于维度旅行的珍贵线索。
descriptions.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

It is a crystalline spherical object most similar to the §YRift Sphere§! technology we have developed that allows us to explore other dimensions.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

descriptions.zh:
鉴于我们最近对星界裂隙的研究，我们发现位于[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]的晶态球状物体与我们开发的§Y裂隙探球§!技术有很多相似之处。

它可能对我们的帝国构成重大未知危险。

另一方面，我们相信它可能包含一些有关维度旅行的珍贵线索。
descriptions.en:
In light of our recent research into Astral Rifts, we have discovered that the crystalline spherical object in [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] bares many similarities to the §YRift Sphere§! technology we have developed.

It may present a significant unknown danger to our empire.

On the other hand, we believe it might contain some valuable insights into dimensional travel.

descriptions.zh:
一个奇怪的物体已经到达[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上。

这个晶态球形物体让人想起我们自己的§Y裂隙探球§!技术，它突然出现在没有任何已知轨迹的地方。

由于与[Root.Capital.GetName]如此接近，这个球体可能对我们的人民构成重大威胁。

另一方面，它很有可能包含有关维度旅行性质的珍贵线索。
descriptions.en:
A strange object has arrived in orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName].

A crystalline sphere reminiscent of our own §YRift Sphere§! technology, it appeared without warning along no known trajectory.

At such close proximity to [Root.Capital.GetName], the sphere may represent a significant danger to our people.

On the other hand, it is also highly likely to contain valuable insights into the nature of dimensional travel.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们已经控制了[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]轨道上的一个奇怪物体。

我们对它的目的和来源不甚知晓。或许，借由未来研究的进展，我们能够找到如何使用它的线索。
descriptions.en:
We have taken control of a strange object in the orbit of [crystal_sphere_system.GetName].

We are unsure of its purpose or origin. Perhaps with some future research we can gain insight on how to approach it.

label.zh: 我们会时刻注意观察它。
label.en: We'll keep an eye on it.

options.script:
name = astral_planes.30.a
set_country_flag = crystal_sphere_event_delayed

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
在§H[From.GetName]§!内附近的§H晶体裂隙§!处出现了一个异常的虫洞。

我们只能推测这是无形异使打开的一个星门，为他们带来援军。我们检测到另一侧的恒星系已经从其他地方被拉入我们的位面。

如果我们选择进入这个地方，我们应该准备我们最强大的舰队。
descriptions.en:
An anomalous wormhole has appeared nearby the §HCrystal Rift§!, in §H[From.GetName]§!.

We can only assume that it is a gateway opened by the Formless to bring them aid. We detect the system on the other side has been pulled into our dimension from somewhere else.

We should prepare our strongest fleets if we choose to enter this place.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一个异常的虫洞。无论我们的舰船试图靠近多近，都会被一股未知的力量推开。在§H[From.GetName]§!恒星系中发生了非常奇怪的事情。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole. No matter how close our vessels attempt to proceed, we are being repelled by an unknown force. Something very odd is happening in the §H[From.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[From.GetName]§!发现了一个异常的虫洞。传感器显示它直接通往星系的中心。这怎么可能？
descriptions.en: We have discovered an anomalous wormhole in §H[From.GetName]§!. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy. How is that possible?

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系中发现的异常虫洞正在剧烈波动。传感器检测到它是通往星系中心的直接通道。

这怎么可能？
descriptions.en:
The anomalous wormhole we discovered in the §H[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]§! system is fluctuating wildly. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy.

How is that possible?

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的细缝发生了失稳，打开了一道通往其他时空的裂隙。

我们应当小心应对。
descriptions.en:
The dimensional scar in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system has destabilized, opening a rift into another place and time.

We should approach with caution.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系发现了一处特别的时空裂隙。也许我们花时间研究一些其特质就可以找到进一步探索的方式。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an extraordinary rift in space and time in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Perhaps if we take time to study its properties we can find a way to explore further.

descriptions.zh:
我们的人终于抵近到触手可及天空中裂缝的地方了。

也许花点时间研究其性质便可以找到进一步探索的方法。我们完全无从得知在它里面到底有什么。
descriptions.en:
Our people have finally reached far enough to touch the scar in our skies.

Perhaps if we take time to study its properties, we can find a way to explore further. We have no way of knowing what may be on the other side.

label.zh: 我们已经达成了先祖不曾触及之事。
label.en: We have done what our ancestors could not.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经揭开了关于如何收集储存这种构成我们宇宙边界的星界物质形成的缥缈丝线的秘密。

这种珍贵稀有的资源可以以诸多方式使用，使我们大受裨益。
descriptions.en:
We have unlocked the secrets behind gathering and containing the volatile threads of astral material that make up the very border of this universe.

This valuable and rare resource can be applied in various ways that will benefit us greatly.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

descriptions.zh:
我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]星系的控制，一并也失去了其中所含的时空裂隙。

我们进一步探索的努力只能暂时告一段落了。
descriptions.en:
We have lost control of the [FromFrom.GetName] system, and the rift in space and time contained within.

Our efforts to reach beyond have been abandoned for now.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName]从一趟寻找因终末而消失的星系的星界裂隙探险中返回了。他熟悉的许多地方已经完全从本现实中消失了。

他还不确定自己回到的是不是正确的维度，显然是受到了一定的认知冲击。
descriptions.en:
[fromfrom.leader.GetName] returned from exploring an Astral Rift to find a galaxy lost to the End. Many of the places they knew have vanished completely from this existence.

They are still uncertain if they returned to the correct dimension at all, and appear to be experiencing a form of cognitive shock as a result.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 维度锁正在失去稳定。我们需要尽快行动避免它完全松脱。
descriptions.en: This Dimensional Lock is destabilizing. We will need to work quickly to prevent it from completely unraveling.

tooltips.zh: 维度锁激活期间，只有得到你允许的舰队可以进入。
tooltips.en: While Dimensional Locks are active, only those fleets with your permission may enter.

options.script:
name = astral_planes.1030.b
custom_tooltip = astral_planes.1030.b.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 维度锁将会过期，将需要由科研船来重新建立。
tooltips.en: This Dimensional Lock will expire, and will need to be re-established with a Science Ship.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经开发出了这种能在星界裂隙的折缝中穿行的科技：§Y裂隙探球§!。

这种球体以高度先进、绝对光滑的纳米材料建成，可以在时空的乱流处无摩擦地滑行。

因为不知道所到地方的情况，每一艘§Y裂隙探球§!都会连接上一条锚定缆线。缆线连接在我们宇宙中的一艘科研船上，以便在发生意外时将我们拉回。
descriptions.en:
We have developed technology that will allow us to slip between the folds of an Astral Rift: §YRift Spheres§!.

Constructed of a highly advanced, perfectly smooth nano-material, the Sphere is able to frictionlessly glide through turbulent areas of space and time.

As we are unsure where we will arrive, each §YRift Sphere§! is connected to an anchor cable. To pull us back in case of emergency, the cable is tethered to a Science Ship in our universe.

label.zh: 那就看看能找到什么吧……
label.en: Let's see what we can find...

options.script: name = astral_planes.2005.a

descriptions.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
descriptions.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as we are receiving transmissions from an unknown entity.

descriptions.zh: 这是什么……你带来了什么傻瓜来帮助你，沙达衮？或者……你给我们提供了食物……
descriptions.en: what is this... what fools have you brought to aid you, shadagon? or perhaps... you have offered us food...

label.zh: 我们被当作猎物，被诱惑到此地？
label.en: Have we been lured here as prey?

options.script: name = astral_planes.3005.a

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
descriptions.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

options.script:
name = ONSCREEN
country_event = { id = astral_planes.3020 }

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh: 更多的即将到来……我们必须封闭这个裂缝……我们是唯一剩下的人……
descriptions.en: more are coming... we must seal this rift... we are all that remains...

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们是唯一剩下的人……我们必须重建……我们需要时间……
descriptions.en: we are all that remains... we must rebuild... we need time...

descriptions.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
descriptions.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

tooltips.zh: 如果我们能够提供大量的星界丝缕，这些生物肯定能够增强他们的防御能力。
tooltips.en: If we were to deliver a large amount of astral thread, these beings could surely enhance their defenses.

options.script:
name = astral_planes.3050.b
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
descriptions.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

tooltips.zh: 被我们所知为无形异使的存在，已经被来自另一个位面的攻击者摧毁。位于亚梓拉士恒星系的传送门也被封印关闭。
tooltips.en: The beings known as the Formless have been destroyed by attackers from another dimension. The portal into the azilash system has sealed shut.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H在不断变化的状态下，这个实体的可见形态在这个现实和另一个现实之间转换。祂的声音共鸣如众多的和声，仿佛同时代表着几个存在。§!

……完成了……封印已经设置完毕……我们的孩子再也找不到这个地方了……
descriptions.en:
§HIn a constant state of flux, this entity's visible form shifts between this reality and another. Their voice resonates as a harmonic multitude, as speaking on behalf of several beings at once.§!

... it is done... the seal is set... never shall our children find this place again...

label.zh: §Y向我们臣服，你们将继续存活。§!
label.en: §YServe under us, and you may yet still live.§!

tooltips.zh: §Y无形异使§!作为一个§Y曙光境§!成为§Y[This.GetName]§!治下的附属国。
tooltips.en: §YThe Formless§! becomes a subject under §Y[This.GetName]§! as a §YLuminarium§!.

descriptions.zh: 这已经被预测……我们会向你们称臣……这是我们的命运……
descriptions.en: this was predicted... we will serve you... this is our fate...

descriptions.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
descriptions.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

descriptions.zh:
永恒王座……轮不到你来取得……
我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
descriptions.en:
the eternal throne... it is not yours to take...
we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

descriptions.zh: 感激……安全……奖励……
descriptions.en: gratefulness... safety... reward...

tooltips.zh: 将一支无形异使舰队交由你控制。
tooltips.en: Grants a Formless fleet under your control.

tooltips.zh: 获得一个随机物理学科技。

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
沙巴纳什……破碎的亲人……永远饥饿……

我们的贪婪……被放大……

罪恶被揭示……

一个巨大的耻辱……
descriptions.en:
shabanash... shattered kin... hungry always...

our greed... amplified...

sins brought to light...

a great shame...

descriptions.zh:
达伽尔……无视……充满愤怒……

我们的愤怒……显现……

他们的冲突永远不会结束……
descriptions.en:
dagaal... heedless... filled with rage...

our wrath... manifest...

their conflicts will never end...

descriptions.zh:
盎宰……王座的追求者……

巨大的嫉妒……

我们被遗忘的概念……
descriptions.en:
onzai... seekers of the throne...

great envy...

our forgotten concept...

label.en: We'd like to ask something else.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
他们的贪婪将被毁灭……

我们知道的方法.……这是一个……频率的问题……？

你的语言中没有这个词……

我们需要……星界材料……
descriptions.en:
their greed is an undoing...

we know of ways... it is a matter of... frequencies...?

your language does not have the word...

we require... astral material...

descriptions.zh:
他们的狂怒漫无目的……

我们知道的方法.……这是一个……频率的问题……？

你的语言中没有这个词……

我们需要……星界材料……
descriptions.en:
their wrath is unfocused...

we know of ways... it is a matter of... frequencies...?

your language does not have the word...

we require... astral material...

descriptions.zh:
他们的欲求实乃愚蠢……

我们知道的方法.……这是一个……频率的问题……？

你的语言中没有这个词……

我们需要……星界材料……
descriptions.en:
their desires are folly...

we know of ways... it is a matter of... frequencies...?

your language does not have the word...

we require... astral material...

label.en: We'd like to ask something else.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 完成了……你的调谐已经完工……
descriptions.en: it is done... your attunement is complete...

label.en: We'd like to ask something else.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
descriptions.en:
§Yzadigal§! of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

options.script: name = DOTDOTDOT

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们还没有结束……沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……

你救了你的亲族……但愚蠢地追求……傲慢……

见证愤怒……然后是遗忘……
descriptions.en:
we are not finished... §Yzadigal§! of shadagon...

you have saved your kin... but foolishly pursue... hubris...

witness fury... then oblivion...

options.script: name = DOTDOTDOT

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh:
建筑师……沙达衮的§Y乍狄伽§!……

我们将吞食你……吸收你的思维……

王座的秘密……你提供的伟大礼物……

现在加入我们……我们将尊重你……
descriptions.en:
the architect... §Yzadigal§! of shadagon...

we will consume you...  incorporate your mind...

the secrets of the throne... a great gift you offer...

join us now... we will honor you...

options.script: name = DOTDOTDOT

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
fire_only_once = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们针对无形异使的侵略行动，已经导致[this.GetName]放弃将舰队委任给我们，这些舰队重新加入他们的队列。
descriptions.en: Our aggressive campaign against the Formless has caused [this.GetName] to abandon their assigned fleets, and rejoin their ranks.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们已成功消灭了在[event_target:formless_system.GetName]中剩下的最后一批无形异使。

剩下的只有一个神秘的装置。一个人只需将自己的[this.species.GetHandNamePlural]放在上面，就能激活它神奇的再生特性。该装置作为一种通道进入星界位面，其中有大量的超维材料经由它自由流动。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully exterminated the last of the remaining Formless in [event_target:formless_system.GetName].

All that remains is a mysterious device. One need simply place their [this.species.GetHandNamePlural] upon it to activate its miraculous regenerative properties. The device functions as a sort of conduit into the astral planes, with incredible quantities of extra-dimensional material flowing freely throughout it.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们知道你……
此刻尚未到我们相遇之时……
descriptions.en:
though we know you...
it is not our time to meet...

options.script:
name = GOODBYE
default_hide_option = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们已经完成了对位于§Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!的§Y星界细缝§!的分析。

它正在从其他地方向我们的宇宙泄漏物质。裂缝周围的物质并不是守恒的——至少从我们的测量方法上来说不是的。尽管处于相对微小的规模，但裂缝似乎增加了我们宇宙的总物质量。

研究这一现象应该能更好地理解这种无法解释的能源来源。
descriptions.en:
We have completed our analysis of the §YAstral Scar§! in §Y[FromFrom.System.GetName]§!.

It is leaking material into our universe from... somewhere else. Matter is not being conserved around the rift - at least not in any way that we can measure. Though on a relatively minute scale, somehow the rift is increasing the overall mass of our universe.

Researching this phenomenon should provide a greater understanding of this unaccounted for source of energy.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们已经确认了在§Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在一个我们宇宙之外的宇宙。

通过裂缝，它的物质位面对我们自己的宇宙施加了巨大的压力，所造成的结果是有一小部分但稳定的物质流动。这一情况的长期效应我们尚未被理解，但在此期间，我们应继续分析其宇宙流出物。
descriptions.en:
We have confirmed the existence of another universe beyond our own in the §Y[FromFromFrom.System.GetName]§! system.

Through the rift, its physical dimensions are placing immense pressure on our own universe, the result of which is a small though steady flow of material. The long-term effects are yet to be understood, but in the meantime we should continue analyzing its cosmic effluence.

label.zh: 另一边存在着怎样的奇景呢？

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
经过仔细分析，我们确认[From.System.GetName]中的§Y星界细缝§!异常不稳定，需要立即干预以防止该恒星系进一步坍缩为引力奇点。

可以考虑将大量喷射而出的§Y星界丝缕§!进行重定向、重新利用，以便“缝合”裂痕。这将修复时空的撕裂，并可能留下大量的星界物质。

或者，我们可以投射大量军火来扩大这处裂痕。我们预测，这么做将有助于我们探索伤痕另一边可能存在的事物。
descriptions.en:
After careful analysis, we've confirmed that the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName] is dangerously unstable and requires immediate intervention to prevent further gravitational singularities forming in this system.

The powerful ejection of §YAstral Threads§! could be redirected and repurposed in order to 'stitch' the scar shut. This would repair the tear in space-time and likely leave behind a significant amount of astral material.

Alternatively, we could deliver a heavy payload of ordinance in an effort to widen the scar. We speculate that this would also allow for further exploration of what may be on the other side.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
经过对其撕裂织构的精细操控，我们成功地完全封印了位于[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!。引力异常自那时起停止，我们在整个过程中回收了大量的§Y星界丝缕§!。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
descriptions.en:
After careful manipulation of its torn fabric, we've managed to fully seal the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName]. Gravitational anomalies have since stopped, and we've recovered a significant quantity of §YAstral Threads§! in the process.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们投送到到[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!核心的军火扩大了时空的折叠。这里曾经只是宇宙织物中的一个小撕裂口，现在成为了一个更大的裂隙，能够让我们进入探索。

由此带来的稳定性使引力异常减弱，我们准备去发现隐藏在其中的事物。
descriptions.en:
The ordinance we sent into the core of the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName] has widened the folds in space and time. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now a larger rift that we are capable of exploring.

The resulting stability has caused the gravitational anomalies to subside, and we are prepared to discover what lies beyond.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
位于[FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!已经朝内坍缩了，并朝周边恒星系抛射出了大量的星界丝缕。这里的宇宙织构曾经出现过一处小小的撕裂，但如今已经是虚无的太空。

无论裂缝另一边的现实如何，都不再对我们构成威胁。
descriptions.en:
The §YAstral Scar§! in [FromFromFromFrom.System.GetName] has collapsed inwardly, ejecting a significant amount of Astral Threads into the nearby system. Where there was once a small tear in the cosmic fabric, there is now empty space.

Whatever reality was on the other side will no longer pose a danger to our own.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

titles.en: The Greatest Show in the Multiverse

descriptions.zh:
我们在这颗小行星上发现的发光物体是一则广告。

这个巨大的展示装置由内部占据小行星的机械基础设施支持。小行星本身在空间中的某一点上异常地悬浮着，不受任何附近物体的引力影响。

广告本身是关于它所称之为“多重宇宙的最佳秀场”的内容。有一个终端可以接受能量币，使我们直接前往这个景点。
descriptions.en:
The brightly lit object we discovered on this asteroid is an advertisement.

This massive display is supported by a mechanical infrastructure occupying the inside of the asteroid it is mounted on. The asteroid itself is anomalously suspended at one point in space, unaffected by the gravitational pull of any nearby object.

The advertisement itself is in reference to what it calls "The Greatest Show in the Multiverse".There is a terminal accepting energy credits for direct transport to the attraction.

label.zh: 重新改造这处标识为我们自己所用。
label.en: Repurpose the sign for our own use.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 在处理完我们的支付款项后，小行星内部的机械开始嗡嗡作响。一股刺眼的蓝光向外射出，精确地分开了时空的织构。当它运转结束时，小行星就消失了，而一道星界裂隙出现在了原地。
descriptions.en: After processing our payment, the machinery within the asteroid whirred into life. A stream of piercing blue light shot outward, meticulously parting the fabric of space and time. Once its work was finished, the asteroid simply vanished, and an Astral Rift was left in its stead.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们用深受认可的本地企业代替了[fromfrom.GetName]的古怪广告商。支付终端被仔细拆解后，我们在里面发现了一小批能量币。
descriptions.en: We have replaced the anomalous advertisement with an endorsement for our own local businesses at [fromfrom.GetName]. The payment terminal was carefully dismantled, revealing a small cache of energy credits within.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 小行星内部机械中所采纳的技术比我们最初预料的要先进。因此，我们的回收工作给我们带来了相当可观的价值。我们发现了各种稀有材料——其中包括数量惊人的§Y星界丝缕§!。这颗中空的小行星一定是被设计成能够以某种方式操纵空间和时间。
descriptions.en: The technology within the asteroid's internal mechanisms were more advanced than initially suspected. As such, its salvage has rewarded us with considerable value. We have uncovered a variety of rare materials - including an anomalous quantity of §YAstral Threads§!. The hollowed asteroid must have been designed to manipulate space and time in some fashion.

label.zh: 我们得好好利用这一切。
label.en: We shall put these to good use.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
某些由[from.System.GetName]的黑洞释放的粒子实际上是§Y星界丝缕§!。这意味着在某个时间点，星界细缝被拉入了黑洞的奇点，然后现在正在缓慢地被喷射出来。这样的事件以前被认为是不可能的。

或许，存在某种方式将高度聚集的§Y星界丝缕§!羽流导入奇点之中，从而让星界细缝被喷射出来，使这个恒星系的空间重新稳定。

然而，若是不采取进一步行动，我们可以继续从安全距离采集这些宇宙织物。
descriptions.en:
Some of the particles being released by the black hole in [from.System.GetName] are, in fact, §YAstral Threads§!. This means that at some point in time an Astral Scar was pulled into its singularity and is now slowly being ejected. Such an event was previously thought impossible.

There may be a way to eject the scar and restabilize this system's space by directing a highly concentrated stream of §YAstral Threads§! into the singularity.

However, taking no further action would allow us to continue harvesting the cosmic fabric from a safe distance.

label.en: Inject astral material into the singularity.
Collect the thread from a safe distance.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
将§Y星界丝缕§!注入奇点立马引起了剧烈的反应，由于黑洞的引力，大量的超维粒子喷涌而出。这些粒子已经聚集成一个悬浮在其引力井中的星界裂隙。

这个天体异常点之前是如何被吸入奇点，我们仍然不了解，但现在我们至少可以调查一下裂隙的另一边有什么存在。
descriptions.en:
The injection of §YAstral Threads§! into the singularity caused an immediate and violent reaction, as a flood of extra-dimensional particles poured forth from the gravitational pull of the black hole. These particles have coalesced into an Astral Rift that is now suspended within its gravity well.

How this celestial anomaly was ever sucked into the singularity in the first place remains unknown, but now we can at least investigate what lies on the other side.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[from.System.GetName]的黑洞将先前被其奇点吸收的星界细缝抛射了出来，随之而来的还有大量被束缚的星界物质。

黑洞的引力现在变得正常了。
descriptions.en:
The black hole in [from.System.GetName] has ejected the Astral Scar that was temporarily absorbed into its singularity, along with a significant amount of trapped astral material.

The gravitational forces of the black hole have since normalized.

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetName]的殖民者发展出了一种爱好，沉迷于星界裂隙 ，其位于行星南半球的可观测天空中。人们激烈地推测它的起源，以及它蕴含着怎样的危险或机遇。

来自[owner.GetName]各地的业余天文爱好者聚集到这颗行星，亲眼见证这番绝景。
descriptions.en:
Colonists on [this.GetName] have developed a fascination with the Astral Rift visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportunities it might present.

Amateur astronomers from across the [owner.GetName] have flocked to the planet to see it for themselves.

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetName]的殖民者发展出了一种爱好，沉迷于星界细缝 ，其位于行星南半球的可观测天空中。人们激烈地推测它的起源，以及它蕴含着怎样的危险或机遇。

来自[owner.GetName]各地的业余天文爱好者聚集到这颗行星，亲眼见证这番绝景。
descriptions.en:
Colonists on [this.GetName] have developed a fascination with the Astral Scar visible in the sky from the planet's southern hemisphere. Rampant speculation exists about its origins, as well as what dangers or opportunities it might present.

Amateur astronomers from across the [owner.GetName] have flocked to the planet to see it for themselves.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这种对当地的星界裂隙产生的爱好在[this.GetName]已经演变成了一股狂热。许多人都报告称，看见了某个在我们世界之外的地方。

其中一个团体宣称这个裂隙通往的是一个发条宇宙的中心，那里有一个机械神，他会给时间表上发条，以在无尽的世界中保持平衡。

与之相反，还有人说他们的幻境中出现了一颗黑色的恒星，它拥有启蒙的关键。
descriptions.en:
The fascination with the local Astral Rift on [this.GetName] has become fanatic. Many report experiencing visions of a world beyond our own.

One group claims that the Rift leads to the center of a clockwork galaxy, where a mechanical god winds a timepiece to maintain balance across infinite worlds.

In contrast, others say their visions have revealed a black star that holds the key to enlightenment.

descriptions.zh:
这种对当地的星界细缝产生的爱好在[this.GetName]已经演变成了一股狂热。许多人都报告称，看见了某个在我们世界之外的地方。

其中一个团体宣称这个裂痕通往的是一个发条宇宙的中心，那里有一个机械神，他会给时间表上发条，以在无尽的世界中保持平衡。

与之相反，还有人说他们的幻境中出现了一颗黑色的恒星，它拥有启蒙的关键。
descriptions.en:
The fascination with the local Astral Scar on [this.GetName] has become fanatic. Many report experiencing visions of a world beyond our own.

One group claims that the Scar leads to the center of a clockwork galaxy, where a mechanical god winds a timepiece to maintain balance across infinite worlds.

In contrast, others say their visions have revealed a black star that holds the key to enlightenment.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
人群之间的割裂在[this.GetName]上日益加剧。殖民者报告的奇怪幻境引发了激烈的辩论，并最终演变为暴力事件。当地领导人呼吁发表一份官方的声明。

尽管可能看起来荒谬，我们被要求为机械神或黑星的存在提供可信说明，作为星界裂隙的解释。
descriptions.en:
The schism between the population on [this.GetName] is worsening. The strange visions reported by the colonists have triggered fierce debates that have finally led to outbreaks of violence. Local leaders are calling for an official proclamation.

As outlandish as it may seem, we are being asked to lend credibility to either the existence of a mechanical god or a black star beyond their Astral Rift.

descriptions.zh:

尽管可能看起来荒谬，我们被要求为机械神或黑星的存在提供可信说明，作为星界细缝的解释。

The schism between the population on [this.GetName] is worsening. The strange visions reported by the colonists have triggered fierce debates that have finally led to outbreaks of violence. Local leaders are calling for an official proclamation.

As outlandish as it may seem, we are being asked to lend credibility to either the existence of a mechanical god or a black star beyond their Astral Scar.

label.en: Let them look to the black star.

label.zh: 无论哪种视景都没有好处。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[this.GetName]上发生了灾难！

人们所经历的相互冲突的视景导致了大规模的动荡。竞相敌对的团体已经拿起了武器，局部的小规模冲突导致了全球范围内的暴力冲突。

这种情况不能继续下去。
descriptions.en:
Disaster on [this.GetName]!

The contrasting visions experienced by the population have resulted in large-scale unrest. The competing groups have taken up arms, with local skirmishes leading to violent clashes all across the planet.

This can not be allowed to continue.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 随着视景中关于钟表神的论述有了可信度，关于星界裂隙的争论显著减少了。与此同时，对其进行研究的公众热情达到了一个空前的高度。
descriptions.en: With the vision of a clockwork god made credible, debate about the Astral Rift has diminished significantly. At the same time, public enthusiasm for its study has never been higher.

descriptions.zh: 随着视景中关于拓展心灵的黑星的论述有了可信度，关于星界裂隙的争论显著减少了。与此同时，对其进行研究的公众热情达到了一个空前的高度。
descriptions.en: With the vision of a mind-expanding black star made credible, debate about the Astral Rift has diminished significantly. At the same time, public enthusiasm for its study has never been higher.

descriptions.zh: 随着视景中关于钟表神的论述有了可信度，关于星界细缝 的争论显著减少了。与此同时，对其进行研究的公众热情达到了一个空前的高度。
descriptions.en: With the vision of a clockwork god made credible, debate about the Astral Scar has diminished significantly. At the same time, public enthusiasm for its study has never been higher.

descriptions.zh: 随着视景中关于拓展心灵的黑星的论述有了可信度，关于星界细缝的争论显著减少了。与此同时，对其进行研究的公众热情达到了一个空前的高度。
descriptions.en: With the vision of a mind-expanding black star made credible, debate about the Astral Scar has diminished significantly. At the same time, public enthusiasm for its study has never been higher.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
所有关于[this.GetName]上的奇怪幻境的公开讨论已被禁止。任何被发现谈论这个禁忌话题的人都会受到严厉的惩罚，这就阻止了公开冲突的发生。

许多殖民者已经转而追求新的热点，但一小部分硬核的业余天文学家仍然享受着这个壮观景象，继续观察星界裂隙。
descriptions.en:
All public discussion of the strange visions on [this.GetName] has been prohibited. Severe punishments for anyone caught broaching the forbidden topic have discouraged open conflict.

Many colonists have moved on to new pursuits, but a core group of amateur astronomers continue to enjoy the sheer spectacle of the Astral Rift.

descriptions.zh:

Many colonists have moved on to new pursuits, but a core group of amateur astronomers continue to enjoy the sheer spectacle of the Astral Scar.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。

我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
descriptions.en:
The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.

The weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the explosive discharges indicates a network of buried launch sites across the planet.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
进一步的分析表明，这颗行星曾经被用作巨大的武器储存库。在静止了数千年之后，个别武器现在开始出现故障，将整个行星变成了一个不稳定的战场。

我们有能力以受控的方式触发所有剩余的弹药。或者，我们可以尝试提取一些武器并在它们爆炸之前将其停用。
descriptions.en:
Further analysis indicates that this planet was once used as an enormous weapons cache. Having sat inactive for thousands of years, individual weapons are now beginning to malfunction, turning the entire planet into an unstable battlefield.

We have the capacity to trigger all remaining munitions in a controlled manner. Alternatively, we could attempt to extract some of the weapons and deactivate them before they explode.

label.zh: 试图回收这些古老的炸药。
label.en: Attempt to recover the ancient explosives.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
在[from.GetName]周围部署了一系列精心设计的炸药之后，我们触发了链式反应，彻底摧毁了这颗行星。

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还产生了一道新的§Y星界裂隙§!。

我们通过理论推导得出，这个裂隙的产生是因为一场极其强大的、能够产生奇点的爆炸，这是由武器储藏库中的某一件武器产生的。
descriptions.en:
After deploying a carefully engineered set of charges around [from.GetName], we triggered a chain reaction that destroyed the planet entirely.

The resulting explosion was so strong that it not only destroyed the planet, but resulted in the formation of a new §YAstral Rift§!.

We theorize that the opening of this rift was caused by a uniquely powerful singularity-generating explosive stored in one of the many weapon caches.

descriptions.zh:
在[from.GetName]周围部署了一系列精心设计的炸药之后，我们触发了链式反应，彻底摧毁了这颗行星。

由此引发的爆炸十分强大，不仅摧毁了行星，还在时空织构中撕扯出了一处裂口，导致了一个我们现在称之为§Y星界裂隙§!的形成。

我们通过理论推导得出，这个裂隙的产生是因为一场极其强大的、能够产生奇点的爆炸，这是由武器储藏库中的某一件武器产生的。
descriptions.en:
After deploying a carefully engineered set of charges around [from.GetName], we triggered a chain reaction that destroyed the planet entirely.

The resulting explosion was so strong that it not only destroyed the planet, but also tore a hole in the fabric of space-time, resulting in the formation of what we are calling an §YAstral Rift§!.

We theorize that the opening of this rift was caused by a uniquely powerful singularity-generating explosive stored in one of the many weapon caches.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们能够为存储在行星表面的武器建立一个提取管线，将处于激活状态的军火变为惰性状态，然后准备收集和分析它们。

在这个行星上建立一个永久殖民地将使我们能够更高效地利用剩余的储藏。
descriptions.en:
We were able to create an extraction pipeline for the weapons stored within the planet's surface, rendering active munitions inert before preparing them for collection and analysis.

Establishing a permanent colony on this planet would allow us to take advantage of the remaining cache more efficiently.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[from.GetName]上的不稳定武器由于自发爆炸引发了一连串的连锁反应，导致该行星完全破裂。

在残骸中，我们发现了大量的§Y易爆微粒§!。这种资源一定是存储在地表下的武器的关键组成部分。
descriptions.en:
The spontaneous explosions of unstable weapons on [from.GetName] culminated in a chain reaction that caused the planet to completely break apart.

Among the debris, we have detected a significant concentration of §YVolatile Motes§!. This resource must have formed a key component of the weapons stored beneath the surface.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 与[FromFromFrom.GetName]的裂隙探球一同从星界裂隙出现的，是一幅引起了我们注意的异常景象：探球的尾迹中跟随着一个休眠的逃生舱。很快，我们就收到了一个简单的求救信号，并附有实时视频。
descriptions.en: Emerging from the Astral Rift alongside the [FromFromFrom.GetName]'s Rift Sphere, an unexpected sight catches our attention: a dormant escape pod trailing in the Sphere's wake. Soon, we receive a simple distress signal, accompanied by a live video feed.

name = ONSCREEN
country_event = { id = astral_planes.6105 }
name = astral_planes.6100.b

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
§H这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。这只生物突然回过神来，挥动触角自我介绍道:§!

啊？怎么？这是哪？抱歉。我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，是布洛葛合众国的探险家和外交官。你听说过人类吗？
descriptions.en:
§HThe repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Abruptly regaining composure, with a flourish of tentacles the creature introduces itself: §!

What- Whe- Where am I? I am sorry. My name is Mercedes Romero, explorer and diplomat of the Blorg Commmonality. Do you know of the Humans?

descriptions.zh:
§H这只令人厌恶的外星人站在我们面前，茫然地沉默着，全身上下只有菌毛在像波浪一样有节奏地起伏着。在注意到我们之后，她几乎要猛扑上来，然后又控制住了自己。§!

你们、你们是人类！？§H*尖叫*§!我——我太抱歉了，从我还是一只萌孢的时候就对你们的文化超级感兴趣！

§H这只外星人伸出了一只触手，令人尴尬地尝试模仿握手动作。§!

我叫梅赛德斯·罗梅罗，很高兴见到你们。
descriptions.en:
§HThe repugnant alien stands before us in dazed silence, its only motion that of its pileus, undulating in a wave like rythm. Upon registering us, it makes a lunging movement before restraining itself.§!

Y- You- You are Humans!? §H*Squeee*§! I- I am sorry, I have been fascinated with your culture ever since I was a little sporeling!

§HThe alien extends a tentacle in an awkward attempt to mimic a handshake.§!

My name is Mercedes Romero and it is my pleasure to meet you.
